# Alpha rules — part pickers

This file holds parts `core` and `pickers`, with helper part `wording`.

`${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` in this file is `workflows-core`'s root, whichever plugin's run reads it.

## Rule index of `alpha`

Every rule name in `alpha`, with the part that holds it; `core` comes with every part. A rule of a helper part, which has no file of its own, is listed with the parts that bring it; load any one of them. Load a part with `Skill(skill: "workflows-core:reference", args: "alpha <part>")`, unless it is already in this conversation word for word.

- `Closed-vocabulary pickers` → `pickers`
- `Key dir not found` → `stops`
- `Wording` → `pickers` or `review`
- `Review gate` → `review`

---

The alpha reference holds the rules a choice list follows.

## Closed-vocabulary pickers

A free-text answer is normalised into the picker's own vocabulary, or re-asked.

## Wording

Helper text: say what the answer means in the picker's own words.
